name: tep

notes.methods: late peaks (N100, P180) may be contaminated by auditory and somatosensory responses to the coil click and scalp sensation
notes.shapes: gabor removed from the default shapes of spec §6.1: one gabor describes a pair of components of opposite sign (as N45 and P60), so the labelled TEP sequence lost a component; layer-2 base cell (two components 2 FWHM apart, SNR 5, 20 replicates): F1 0.55 with gabor, 1.00 without. Add it back with presets.derive('tep', shapes=('gaussian', 'skewed_gaussian', 'gabor')) for oscillatory bursts (CHANGELOG, step S15)
notes.background: constant instead of the double exponential of spec §6.1, with reject_cancelling: two exponentials of opposite signs form a bump (the biexponential component shape), which took the N100 or the P30-N45-P60 complex on ds002094; alone, either change moves the degeneracy to the other term. On 8 development subjects N45 and N100 were both labelled on 6 of 8 with ICA cleaning (3 of 8 with v1.0) and the components not resolvable fell from 56 to 19 over 32 fits; on the 12 held-out subjects 2 of 12 on all channels (2 with v1.0) and 6 of 12 on the 17 inner channels (2) (CHANGELOG, REQ-275, preset tep 1.1). Restore with presets.derive('tep', background='double_exponential', fit_extras={})

validation: ds002094: REQ-275 not met (N45 and N100 on the channel of maximal response for 8 of 20 subjects with ICA cleaning added, 8 of 20 with the preset's cleaning on the 17 inner channels)
